subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

They __had to cultivate crops__ which the company asked them to do.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"They had to cultivate crops which the company asked them to do."** is grammatically correct as it stands.
 
• The structure and the verb tense are appropriate for the context provided.
 
• No additional changes are necessary to improve the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3** (No improvement).

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They **had to cultivate crops** which the company asked them to do."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **had to cultivates crops** – This option is incorrect due to the subject-verb agreement error.
 
• **had cultivating crops** – This option is grammatically incorrect as it uses the wrong verb form.
 
• **cultivate cropping** – This option is incorrect as it uses an inappropriate verb form.
 
• **No improvement** – This is the correct option as the original sentence is already correct.
